# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.1.0

- Added the `ringcentral-team-chat` MCP server pointing at RingCentral's hosted RingEX Team Chat endpoint (`https://mcp.labs.ringcentral.com/ringex/v1.1.0/team-chat`).

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `ringcentral` MCP server pointing at RingCentral's hosted RingEX Phone endpoint (`https://mcp.labs.ringcentral.com/ringex/phone`).
- Logo: RingCentral's mark from the `ringcentral` GitHub organization avatar, 256×256.
